name: code-review-local
description: Local code review using jj (jujutsu) on a given revset. Runs the same multi-agent confidence-scored review as /code-review, but against jj revisions rather than a GitHub PR, and posts the result back into the chat instead of to GitHub.

author.name: Adapted from Anthropic's /code-review plugin by Boris Cherny, first iteratoion was vibe coded.
